headline: Reliance Industries Limited: Allotment of Securities
sum: Allotment of Securities - We wish to inform that the Company has today allotted 13,00,000 Unsecured, Redeemable, Non-Convertible Debentures ("NCDs") of the face value of Rs. 1,00,000 each ("PPD Series R"), issued on private placement basis.
